column1: # Guard sites (docs/ENGINE_CRATE.md, "Guard sites"; crates/engine-core/src/guard.rs): the exe instructions where a
# translation has a `guard_site!`, one row each. Columns: the instruction's address, the function it is in, the
# fixes preset's row that answers there, and what the row does there. A test (crates/host/src/crash_guards.rs)
# holds the table to the translations' sites and to the row's guard, both ways.
